system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: At first almost nothing is visible: a deep, matte black field fills the image, with only the faintest separation between the ground and the air above it. <Subject:darkness> presses around the edges of the space, thick enough that the background has no readable horizon or fixed landmark. Then <Subject:car> emerges from the deepest part of the shadow, moving straight forward. Its body reads as a low, broad silhouette; the hood stays smooth and level, the roofline is barely distinct, and the wheels turn slowly enough to be seen individually against the dark ground. Faint highlights gather along the leading edge, then slide across the hood and fenders as the vehicle clears the heaviest shadow. The car does not swerve or change speed abruptly; its path stays centered and deliberate. As it advances, the surrounding darkness opens into a graded field of charcoal and near-black, revealing a flat, unmarked surface under the tires and a low, indistinct background behind the vehicle. The tires carry a thin rim of reflected light, while the rear of the car remains partly veiled in shadow. By the end, the car is visibly present in the near-middle distance, still dark and simple in form, and the space around it has resolved enough to separate the moving vehicle from the night.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: The frame opens on a nearly solid black field; <Subject:car> is little more than a darker mass within it.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low engine hum and soft tire roll begin under the scene.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: <Subject:car> moves forward out of the heaviest shadow, its hood and fenders catching faint highlights as the silhouette separates from the background.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: The ground beneath <Subject:car> becomes readable as a flat, unmarked surface, and <Subject:darkness> recedes into a graded charcoal background.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:4: <Subject:car> reaches the near-middle distance and continues forward, still dark and unadorned, with its rear partly veiled.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:5: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.soundscape: A low engine hum and soft tire roll over a quiet, dark ambience.
